effects: Node {type, x, y, label} appears under node_id, keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0, role=button).
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism (see idempotency_mechanism). Replaying returns the recorded node creation result.
actions.name: add_node
preconditions: node_id equals n + (current guide seq + 1): ascending, no gaps.
type is one of the four frozen node types.
label is 1-200 characters.
actions.undo_inverse: Delete the node and any edges touching it.

effects: Same as add_node, with type fixed to collection.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded node creation result.
actions.name: add_collection_point
preconditions: Same as add_node.
type is implied collection and is not a parameter.
actions.undo_inverse: Delete the node and any edges touching it.

effects: Edge {a, b, cat} appended to the edges array and drawn on the canvas.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded edge result; the duplicate-pair guard would also fire on a naive retry, but the key check runs first so replay is a clean no-op.
actions.name: connect
preconditions: Both nodes exist.
a differs from b (no self-loops).
The pair is not already connected in either direction.

effects: The named field is updated in guide state; the node is redrawn.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded set result; the recorded result includes the old value for audit.
actions.name: set_field

value.type: string for label (1-200 chars); number 40-600 for x; number 40-380 for y

preconditions: Node exists.
field is one of label, x, y. Unknown fields are rejected.
Value within the field's range. Out-of-range coordinates are rejected, not clamped.
actions.undo_inverse: Restore the previous value of the field.

effects: Annotation stored in the session layer under node_id.
Appears in run_check output as a cited range or a verify flag.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded annotation result.
actions.name: set_retention

as_of.type: string, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future

statute.type: string, min 8 chars, must name act and section

preconditions: Node exists.
range_min_years < range_max_years (a single number is rejected).
statute names the act and the section, unless verify_only is true.
as_of is a real calendar date, not in the future.
Law 25 is never accepted as the source of a number: it sets no retention periods.
actions.undo_inverse: Remove the annotation (restore the previous one if the node already had one).

effects: Confirmation recorded in the session layer with the current item index.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded confirmation.
actions.name: confirm_node
preconditions: Node exists.

effects: Flag recorded in the session layer.
The executor pauses the recipe at the flagged point until the flag is cleared by a human or by a later flag-clearing action.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded flag; it does not create a second flag.
actions.name: flag_for_review
preconditions: At least one of node_id or item_index is present.
The referenced node or item index exists.

effects: A check report is produced: per-check pass/fail, per-node findings, verify flags. The report never contains a compliance verdict.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism, but this action is non-mutating: replay returns the recorded report without re-running the checks.
actions.name: run_check

checks.type: array of enum: label_coverage, connectivity, retention_cited, edge_categories; min 1, unique

preconditions: checks is non-empty.
Every check name is known.
actions.undo_inverse: None (non-mutating). undo_last skips this action when scanning for the last mutating action.

effects: The guide downloads data-map-inventory.xls (Sheets Nodes/Noeuds and Connections/Liens per the freeze doc).
actions.idempotency: Recorded under the uniform mechanism: replay returns the recorded result and does not trigger a second download.
actions.name: export
preconditions: format is xls; anything else is rejected loudly.
Canvas has at least one node.
actions.undo_inverse: None (non-mutating for canvas state). undo_last skips this action.

effects: The referenced recipe item is marked skipped; the executor advances past it without executing.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded skip marker; the item stays skipped, it is not skipped twice.
actions.name: skip_recipe_item
preconditions: item_index is a valid recipe item.
The item has not already executed.
actions.undo_inverse: Unmark the skip (edge case; normally skips stand).

effects: The most recent mutating applied action is reversed via its undo_inverse.
The undone action's idempotency key moves to a tombstone set so a stale replay can never resurrect it.
undo_last is itself recorded under its own idempotency key.
actions.idempotency: Safe to replay: the recorded result names the action that was undone and its inverse outcome. A replay returns that recorded result instead of undoing a second action.
actions.name: undo_last
preconditions: At least one mutating action has been applied in this session.
actions.undo_inverse: Re-apply the undone action only if its tombstone is cleared by an explicit operator command (not part of Phase 0 recipes).

effects: The snapshot is sealed with the abort reason; no further items execute.
actions.idempotency: Uniform mechanism. Replaying returns the recorded abort; the session stays terminated.
actions.name: abort_session
actions.undo_inverse: None. A terminated session is never resumed.

description: Every valid action at every step, enumerated like a command list. The recipe intents (add_node through export, confirm_node, flag_for_review) appear here as executable actions; the recovery actions (undo_last, skip_recipe_item, flag_for_review, abort_session) are available at every step. flag_for_review is both an intent and a recovery action.

idempotency_mechanism.definition: Every action carries an idempotency key = SHA-256, hex-encoded, of the UTF-8 bytes of recipe_id + U+0000 + decimal item_index + U+0000 + action_name. The session keeps an applied-keys set mapping each key to its recorded result. If a key is already applied, the executor returns the recorded result and performs no work: replay is a no-op.
idempotency_mechanism.example: Key for the connect at item 3 of recipe cafe-nord-sample-01: SHA-256("cafe-nord-sample-01\x003\x00connect").
